synopsis: Join the Rebel crusade against the forces of Darth Vader and the evil Empire!This pocket manual is an introduction to the T-65 X-wing, the Alliance's most advanced starfighter. Inside you'll find out all about the craft that Luke Skywalker used to destroy the Death Star - its origins and design, flight-handling and weapons systems, and unique history in battle.Inside are three pop-up tactical diagrams of the X-wing in action - including an amazing three-dimensional fold-out of the craft in flight - and more than 20 photographic stills from the Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition movies.Get ready for intergalactic adventure - and may the Force be with you?!?!
title: X-wing: A Pocket Manual
